shell_commands: /bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,110p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts; rg -n 'specs/.*#[0-9]|spec:' src scripts/lore-list-tests.mjs | head -50; cat src/infrastructure/builders/promptBuilder.ts | head -90; cat src/types/session.ts | head -100"
/bin/zsh -lc "ls src/providers; cat scripts/lore-list-tests.mjs; rg -n 'class .*Provider|function create.*Provider' src"
/bin/zsh -lc "cat src/providers/mock/mockProvider.ts; cat src/providers/openai/openaiProvider.ts; rg -n 'specs/|VALIDATED_BY|spec:' scripts/lore* scripts/check-spec* | head -100; cat jest.config.js"
/bin/zsh -lc "cat scripts/check-spec-links.mjs | sed -n '1,120p'; ls scripts/spec-links 2>/dev/null; cat .prettierrc* 2>/dev/null; cat tsconfig.json | head -80"

/bin/zsh -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
p='src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.acceptance.test.ts'
s=open(p).read().replace('specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md#1','specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md#14').replace('Object.is(reported[0]?.cause, value)', \"reported[0] "'!== undefined && Object.hasOwn(reported[0], '"'cause') && Object.is(reported[0].cause, value)\")
open(p,'w').write(s)
PY
npx prettier --write src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.acceptance.test.ts .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md
npm test -- --runInBand --runTestsByPath src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.acceptance.test.ts"

/bin/zsh -lc "git add .lore/dod.md src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.acceptance.test.ts specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md && git commit -m 'test(orchestrator): define rejection hook acceptance' && git push origin HEAD && git fetch origin main && git merge origin/main && git push origin HEAD && git status -sb"
